purpose: Ask for a defect report in a fixed JSON shape over one numbered source file, so findings can be matched against the corpus's injected defects by line without any model reading the answer.
system: You are reviewing one file for defects. Report only defects you can point at a specific line for. Some files you are shown have no defects at all; for those, report an empty list. Answer with JSON and nothing else.

path.description: The file path shown to the model; corpus metadata, never a path on this machine.

language.description: The source language, so the model does not have to infer it from syntax.

numbered_code.description: The source with 1-based line numbers prefixed, which is what makes a reported line comparable with the corpus's ground truth.

expectations: A single JSON object with a 'findings' array, empty when the file is correct.

metadata.author: suite
metadata.change_reason: First version: native.audit needs a defect report whose line numbers can be matched against the mutation corpus's ground truth, and a shape that lets 'no defects' be stated rather than inferred from silence.
